latest.title: From Cloud Infrastructure to AI-Driven Development: My First Hands-on with AI-DLC, Kiro, and Claude Code
latest.description: Cloud infrastructure engineer's first hands-on with AI-DLC at AWS Summit Japan 2026 Hackathon. Three AIs, three roles: Claude (claude.ai) for concept sparring, Kiro for implementation, Claude Code (CLI) for diff review. Real catches: Pinpoint EoS, Cognito x NIST gaps, cross-document drift. Why role separation surfaces what single-agent self-review misses. A solo one-week sprint over Japan's Golden Week.

latest.title: Como o AWS Builder Center me ajudou a sair do aprendizado solto para uma direção mais clara na tecnologia
latest.description:
Sou Vithor Torelli, estudante de Engenharia de Software, e neste artigo compartilho como o AWS Builder Center começou a mudar minha forma de enxergar aprendizado, prática e direção dentro da tecnologia.

Mais do que consumir conteúdo, comecei a entender como conectar estudos com o mercado real e com áreas que quero seguir no futuro.

latest.title: Why You Should Not Create Database Connections Inside AWS Lambda Handlers
latest.description: Learn why creating database connections inside AWS Lambda handlers can lead to latency, connection storms, and “too many connections” errors in Amazon RDS PostgreSQL and MySQL workloads. This article explains Lambda execution environments, cold starts, warm starts, global scope connection reuse, and how Amazon RDS Proxy helps build scalable and resilient serverless architectures.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: ASET – Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth
trending.description: ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is an AI-powered claim verification platform built on AWS that verifies scientific claims against 1.2M+ peer-reviewed papers across 8 domains — and automatically fetches and permanently stores new papers from arXiv, PubMed, etc. when gaps are found, making the knowledge base self-growing with every query. From typed claims to YouTube videos and uploaded documents, ASET delivers evidence-backed trust scores in under 10 seconds.

trending.description: Small moments, repeated daily, reveal what single snapshots never can - patterns that quietly signal neurological risk. NeuroVoice is a multimodal Parkinson’s screening platform that tracks pattern over time to detect subtle neurological changes early.
